ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate the recent Medicaid fraud scheme in Minnesota and follow the money to determine the extent of the issue.
questions: How widespread is Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
What are the consequences for those involved?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a larger pattern of fraud and corruption, and could lead to further investigations and convictions.
